items.title: What's new in Varnish? New features in the high-performance caching proxy - SREday Amsterdam 2026
items.summary: Slides for my talk about what's new in Varnish 9. Presented at SREday Amsterdam 2026.More information about the event can be found here: https://feryn.eu/presentations/what-s-new-in-varnish-new-features-in-the-high-performance-caching-proxy-sreday-amsterdam-2026.Notable new features in Varnish 9 are:- Native end-to-end TLS support- Dynamic backends- Local file server support- FastCGI support- Tag-based cache invalidation- Response body manipulation- Structured JSON logging- OpenTelemetry support- A rich collection of extra Varnish modulesVarnish Cache users can run Varnish in a Kubernetes cluster, either as a separate deployment, or as a Gateway API that acts as a native Kubernetes router, with Varnish caching capabilities.For developers who want to develop their own VMODs, Varnish also has a comprehensive Rust framework that makes module development easier. See https://www.varnish.org/ for more information about Varnish Cache and about the Varnish 9 release.
